description: Batch sizes of KernelBench level 2 problem 37 (Matmul_Swish_Sum_GroupNorm) at in_features 1024, out_features 4096, 64 groups. The original sweep was 4096 to 65536 rows; it is extended down to 256 so that the performance cases span 256x. Batches 1, 3, 100, 128 and 1000 are correctness-only boundary and partial-tile shapes.
